title: Investigatory data administrator
description:
BDS Recruitment are looking for 2 temporary administrators on a remote basis with occasional travel to Bradford. The position is working with a local housing association on an initial 3 month basis for a new project.

Hours are 37.5 per week worked Monday to Friday 9am - 5pm

14.35 paye or 18.52 umbrella

The post holder will be responsible for completing a number of repetitive tasks to resolve data issues in the Northgate system with guidance and support from the data resolution manager. This will be extended for you to complete some investigatory data work to help resolve some data issues so a curious mind alongside an eye for detail would be beneficial for this opportunity.

Criteria:

Strong Administrative background preferably within an IT Environment

Strong attention to detail with a passion for data excellence

Experience of compliance, with the ability to operate flexibly across technical, compliance, and governance domains.

Expertise in data quality management, with a strong attention to detail and issue resolution.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite and compliance management software

The ability to work self-directed, and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

Please apply now for immediate consideration.

title: Project Support Administrator
description:
Belmont Recruitment are currently looking for a Project Support Administrator to join Bradford Council's Children and Family Service on an initial 3-6 month temporary contract. This is a full-time role working 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide project support to the delivery of projects and best value reviews within the Children and Families service.
- Work closely with Contract and Quality Officers to support the smooth delivery of review activity.
- Collect, collate and maintain accurate project and service information.
- Monitor project activity, progress and agreed actions.
- Support the recording and reporting of the impact and outcomes of best value reviews.
- Prepare reports, briefings and management information as required.
- Maintain project documentation, records, action logs and supporting evidence.
- Liaise with internal teams and stakeholders to gather information and ensure deadlines are met.
- Identify gaps, issues or concerns within project information and escalate where appropriate.
- Support meetings, including preparing information, recording actions and following up outstanding tasks.

Requirements:
- Experience providing project or business support.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience maintaining accurate records and project documentation.

Please apply with an up to date CV ASAP if this role would be of interest to you.

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking for part time receptionists to be responsible for undertaking a wide range of reception duties and the provision of general support to the multidisciplinary team. we have two roles available on at 25.5 hours and one at 20.5 hours spread across 4 days: Mon: 6 hours, 8AM - 2PM Tues: 9 hours, 8AM - 6PM Wed: 5 hours, 8AM - 1PM Fri: 5.5 hours, 1PM - 6:30PM OR Mon: 5 hours, 8AM - 1PM Tues: 5 hours, 8AM - 1PM Wed: 5.5 hours, 1PM - 6:30PM Thurs: 5 hours, 8AM - 1PM Duties can include but are not limited to, greeting, and directing patients, effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, processing of information, and assisting patients as required. To act as the central point of contact for patients, the distribution of information, messages, and enquiries for the clinical team, liaising with multidisciplinary team members and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. The following are the core responsibilities of the receptionist. There may be on occasion, a requirement to carry out other tasks; this will be dependent upon factors such as workload and staffing levels: a. Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointment system b. Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments c. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers request appropriately d. Front desk duties, including correct procedure for arriving patients. e. Prescription requests f. Signpost patients to the correct service g. Initiating contact with and responding to, requests from patients, team members and external agencies h. Read code data on SystmOne i. Photocopy documentation as required j. Data entry of new and temporary registrations and relevant patient information as required k. Input data into the patients healthcare records as necessary l. Direct requests for information i.e., SAR, insurance / solicitors letters and DVLA forms to the Medical Secretary. m. Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner n. Carry out system searches as requested o. Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area always p. Monitor and maintain the reception area and notice boards q. Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested

title: Receptionist
location: Shipley, BD18 3EG, Shipley, BD18 3EE, Bradford, BD10 9AZ
description: As a key member of the Patient Services team you will be responsible for providing an efficient reception function that includes some specific administration duties. To ensure the front of house service of meeting and greeting is welcoming and portrays our standards of high quality, professional and patient-focused care. To ensure a high focus on customer satisfaction by dealing with queries in a speedy and accurate manner, applying emotionally conscious responses as relevant. To deal with patients and visitors in a courteous manner, using your skills to ensure matters are dealt with efficiently; providing effective management to patient demand, and reducing undue delay or queues at the front desk/phones To work to protocols with regard booking appointments, repeat prescriptions, ordering of patient transport including emergency ambulances and all other duties as explained to you by the Patient Services Manager. To deal with general queries and liaise effectively with clinicians and other staff as required. To support clinicians during their clinics by dealing with their queries and tasks as requested. This may be the need for some stock in their rooms, following up an appointment with the hospital, or other ad hoc requests. To provide chaperoning service where requested by the clinician and/or patient. To ensure patient confidentiality, including the use of the computer system and visibility of the screen as well as the transfer of written and verbal communication. To converse with patients and visitors by speaking clearly, precisely and with confidence both over the phone and face-to-face at the desk. To signpost patients to the most appropriate service.
